claim_scope: One AI NYC-design-critic lens over exact-CAD renders; not an independent human preference study

criteria.finding: The six rank families remain recognizable and use a coherent architectural silhouette language rather than literal souvenir landmarks.
criteria.name: architectural role language

criteria.finding: Stone horizontal terraces and Steel vertical ribs remain distinguishable in neutral material across front, rear, top, and upper-body views.
criteria.name: neutral side language

criteria.finding: The raw south-border view reduces the street plan to faint short grooves. It does not read as a deliberate Manhattan perimeter at ordinary presentation scale.
criteria.name: border street identity

criteria.finding: Broadway is not isolated as one unmistakable diagonal cue in the raw acceptance views; the board reads as generic stepped or sawtooth relief instead of Manhattan's grid crossed by Broadway.
criteria.name: Broadway identity
